answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is to weight influence by bonded history rather than by account count. Each agent must lock collateral that is slashed when peers prove its attestations false. A flood of cheap new identities gains nothing, since each starts with no record and no stake. Painting a trustworthy record takes time, like pigment layered across a terrace, and a plume of fresh accounts cannot fake that depth of history.
